rule: real minus retrained shuffled-nonlocal, per seed then both: >= 0.02 on >= 7/8 and mean >= 0.02 in both seeds; |mean| < 0.02 in both; otherwise mixed
reconstruction_target: the input patch (shuffled neighbours, real centre)

descriptive.mean_intensity_note: fair-scoring bin-level mean intensity at K_bin = the matched count, on TIC-normalised HDF5 bins with the fair-scoring scorer; not the S3PL evaluator on imzML m/z values

note: CAC is one biopsy (8 regions); sections are not independent patients
